_doc: Rules of the PostToolUse hook hooks/edit-check.py (Edit|Write): per-file lint with the project's linter + CLAUDE.md anti-patterns on the added text.

linters: order = priority when two configs sit in the same folder; the config nearest to the file always wins. Walks up folder by folder from the file to $HOME (excluded) or /. A config_files entry is a string or {name, contains} (contains: substring required in the file, e.g. [tool.ruff).

bin_path: looked up walking upwards from the config folder (covers npm-workspaces hoisting). Config without binary = no lint; transitive binary without config = no lint. Nothing global is assumed on PATH.
Linter exit codes: 1 = findings sent to the model; 0 = clean; anything else (2, 126, 127), a timeout or a failed start = the linter could not run -> nothing for the model, one line on stderr.

antipatterns.rules: line-by-line regexes on the added text (Edit.new_string / Write.content), never on the re-read file. unless_line_regex: the line is skipped if it matches. skip_comment_lines: skips lines starting with //, #, *, /*.
antipatterns.exclude_path_regex only applies to the anti-patterns (lint also runs on tests and configs).
Always informative (additionalContext), never blocking. Kill switch: touch ~/.claude/edit-check.off.

rules.message: silent env var fallback: use an assertEnv() that throws at boot, or gate on NODE_ENV !== 'production' (CLAUDE.md "Silent fallbacks")
silent env var fallback: raise an error at startup when the variable is missing, or gate on the dev environment (CLAUDE.md "Silent fallbacks")
hard-coded local URL: import it from the config (CLAUDE.md "No hardcoded values")
